signed-in user, who has\n163\t    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n164\t    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n165\t    if user.needs_setup:\n166\t        raise SetupRequired\n167\t    return user\n168\t\n169\t\n170\tclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n171\t    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n172\t\n173\t\n174\tdef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n175\t    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n176\t    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n177\t    user = signed_in_user(request)\n178\t    if user.role != \"admin\":\n179\t        raise AdminRequired\n180\t    return user\n181\t\n182\t\n183\tdef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n184\t    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n185\t    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n186\t\n187\t\n188\tdef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n189\t    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n190\t\n191\t\n192\tasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n193\t    return redirect(\"/login\")\n194\t\n195\t\n196\tasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n197\t    return PlainTextResponse(\"只有管理员可以使用此页面。\", status_code=403)\n198\t\n199\t\n200\tasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n201\t    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n202\t=== app/accounts.py\n203\t\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n204\t\n205\tPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\n206\ta random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\n207\tcookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\n208\teven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n209\t\n210\tAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n211\t\"\"\"\n212\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n213\t\n214\timport secrets\n215\timport sqlite3\n216\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n217\t\n218\tfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\n219\tfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n220\t\n221\t_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n222\t# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n223\t# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n224\t_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n225\t\n226\tBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\n227\tDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n228\t\n229\t\n230\tclass Refused(Exception):\n231\t    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n232\t\n233\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n234\t        super().__init__(message)\n235\t        self.message = message\n236\t\n237\t\n238\tclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n239\t    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n240\t\n241\t    def __init__(self) -> None:\n242\t        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n243\t\n244\t\n245\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n246\tclass User:\n247\t    id: int\n248\t    email: str\n249\t    role: str\n250\t    display_name: str | None\n251\t    state: str\n252\t    needs_setup: bool\n253\t\n254\t\n255\tdef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n256\t    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n257\t                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n258\t                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n259\t\n260\t\n261\tdef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n262\t    try:\n263\t        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n264\t    except VerifyMismatchError:\n265\t        return False\n266\t\n267\t\n268\tdef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n269\t    return email.strip().lower()\n270\t\n271\t\n272\tdef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n273\t                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n274\t                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n275\t    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n276\t    try:\n277\t        cur = conn.execute(\n278\t            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n279\t            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n280\t            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n281\t             int(needs_setup), state),\n282\t        )\n283\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n284\t        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n285\t            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n286\t        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n287\t            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n288\t        raise\n289\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n290\t    return _user_from_row(row)\n291\t\n292\t\n293\tdef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n294\t    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n295\t    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n296\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n297\t                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n298\t    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n299\t    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n300\t    if row is None or not password_ok:\n301\t        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n302\t    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n303\t    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n304\t        raise AccountDeactivated\n305\t    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n306\t    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n307\t                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n308\t    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n309\t\n310\t\n311\tdef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n312\t    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n313\t\n314\t\n315\tMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\n316\tMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n317\t\n318\t\n319\tdef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n320\t                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n321\t    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n322\t    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n323\t    display_name = display_name.strip()\n324\t    if not display_name:\n325\t        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n326\t    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n327\t        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n328\t    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n329\t        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n330\t    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n331\t        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n332\t    if password != password_confirm:\n333\t        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n334\t    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n335\t                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n336\t    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n337\t        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n338\t    try:\n339\t        conn.execute(\n340\t            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n341\t            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n342\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n343\t        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n344\t\n345\t\n346\tdef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n347\t    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n348\t    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n349\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? WHERE email = ?\",\n350\t                 (state, _normalise_email(email)))\n351\t\n352\t\n353\tdef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n354\t    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n355\t    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n356\t    if not session_id:\n357\t        return None\n358\t    row = conn.execute(\n359\t        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n360\t        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n361\t        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n362\t    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n363\t=== app/game.py\n364\t\"\"\"The game: Game Terms (so far only Heroes) and Patches.\n365\t\n366\tA Hero is a Game Term with an official Chinese and an official English name.\n367\tIts URL slug is derived from the English Official name.\n368\t\n369\tA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\n370\tPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n371\t\n372\tAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n373\t\"\"\"\n374\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n375\t\n376\timport re\n377\timport sqlite3\n378\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n379\t\n380\t\n381\tclass Refused(Exception):\n382\t    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n383\t\n384\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n385\t        super().__init__(message)\n386\t        self.message = message\n387\t\n388\t\n389\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n390\tclass Patch:\n391\t    id: int\n392\t    name: str\n393\t    is_current: bool\n394\t\n395\t\n396\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n397\tclass Hero:\n398\t    id: int\n399\t    name_zh: str\n400\t    name_en: str\n401\t    slug: str\n402\t\n403\t\n404\tdef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n405\t    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n406\t                slug=row[\"slug\"])\n407\t\n408\t\n409\tdef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n410\t    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n411\t    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n412\t\n413\t\n414\tdef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n415\t                            name_en: str, hero_id: int | None = None\n416\t                            ) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n417\t    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n418\t    either name is missing or another Hero already has that slug.\"\"\"\n419\t    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n420\t    if not name_zh:\n421\t        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n422\t    if not name_en:\n423\t        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n424\t    slug = slugify(name_en)\n425\t    if not slug:\n426\t        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n427\t    clash = conn.execute(\n428\t        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms\"\n429\t        \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n430\t        (slug, hero_id)).fetchone()\n431\t    if clash:\n432\t        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n433\t                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n434\t    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n435\t\n436\t\n437\tdef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> Hero:\n438\t    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the slug is taken.\"\"\"\n439\t    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n440\t    cur = conn.execute(\n441\t        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug)\"\n442\t        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?)\", (name_zh, name_en, slug))\n443\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n444\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n445\t    return _hero_from_row(row)\n446\t\n447\t\n448\tdef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n449\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n450\t                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n451\t    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n452\t\n453\t\n454\tdef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n455\t              name_en: str) -> None:\n456\t    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug follows the English name.\n457\t    Raises Refused as add_hero does.\"\"\"\n458\t    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en, hero_id)\n459\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, slug = ?\"\n460\t                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, slug, hero_id))\n461\t\n462\t\n463\tdef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n464\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n465\t                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n466\t    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n467\t\n468\t\n469\tdef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n470\t    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n471\t    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n472\t    name = name.strip()\n473\t    if not name:\n474\t        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n475\t    try:\n476\t        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n477\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n478\t        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n479\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n480\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n481\t    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n482\t\n483\t\n484\tdef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n485\t    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n486\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n487\t    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n488\t            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n489\t=== app/main.py\n490\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n491\t\n492\tT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\n493\tTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\n494\there. Keep this file small.\n495\t\"\"\"\n496\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n497\t\n498\tfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\n499\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n500\t\n501\tfrom app import settings, web\n502\tfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game\n503\tfrom app.web import templates\n504\t\n505\t\n506\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n507\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n508\t                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n509\t    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n510\t                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n511\t                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n512\t    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n513\t    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n514\t    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n515\t    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n516\t\n517\t    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n518\t    def admin_home(request: Request):\n519\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n520\t            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n521\t        )\n522\t\n523\t    @app.get(\"/\")\n524\t    def public_home(request: Request):\n525\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n526\t            request, \"public/home.html\",\n527\t            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n528\t        )\n529\t\n530\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n531\t    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n532\t    app.include_router(game.router)\n533\t    return app\n534\t\n535\t\n536\tapp = create_app()\n537\t=== app/settings.py\n538\t\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\n539\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n540\t\n541\timport os\n542\tfrom pathlib import Path\n543\t\n544\tROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n545\tTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\n546\tSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n547\t\n548\tSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\n549\tSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n550\t# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n551\t# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\n552\tBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n553\t\n554\t\n555\tdef database_path() -> Path:\n556\t    \"\"\"Read on every connect, so tests can point CMS_DATABASE at a temp file.\"\"\"\n557\t    return Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\n558\t=== app/publish.py\n559\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n560\t\n561\tT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\n562\trender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n563\t\n564\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n565\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n566\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n567\t\"\"\"\n568\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n569\t\n570\timport shutil\n571\tfrom pathlib import Path\n572\t\n573\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n574\t\n575\tfrom app import settings\n576\t\n577\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n578\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n579\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n580\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n581\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n582\t\"\"\"\n583\t\n584\t\n585\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n586\t    return Environment(\n587\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n588\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n589\t    )\n590\t\n591\t\n592\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n593\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n594\t    if out.exists():\n595\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n596\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n597\t    env = environment()\n598\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n599\t    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n600\t        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n601\t            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n602\t            home_path=\"index.html\",\n603\t        )\n604\t    )\n605\t    return out\n606\t=== app/routes/__init__.py\n607\t=== app/routes/auth.py\n608\t\"\"\"Login, logout, and first-login setup.\"\"\"\n609\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n610\t\n611\tfrom typing import Annotated\n612\t\n613\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\n614\t\n615\tfrom app import accounts, db\n616\tfrom app.accounts import User\n617\tfrom app.web import (flash, home_for, redirect, signed_in_user_mid_setup,\n618\t                     start_session, templates)\n619\t\n620\trouter = APIRouter()\n621\t\n622\t\n623\t@router.get(\"/login\")\n624\tdef login_form(request: Request):\n625\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/login.html\",\n626\t                                      {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": \"\"})\n627\t\n628\t\n629\t@router.post(\"/login\")\n630\tdef accounts.log_in(conn, email, password)\n635\t    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n636\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n637\t            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n638\t            {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": email, \"error\": refused.message},\n639\t            status_code=403 if isinstance(refused, accounts.AccountDeactivated)\n640\t            else 401)\n641\t    start_session(request, session_id)\n642\t    return redirect(home_for(user))\n643\t\n644\t\n645\t@router.post(\"/logout\")\n646\tdef logout(request: Request):\n647\t    with db.connect() as redirect(\"/login\")\n652\t\n653\t\n654\t@router.get(\"/admin/setup\")\n655\tdef setup_form(request: Request,\n656\t               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)]):\n657\t    if not user.needs_setup:\n658\t        return redirect(home_for(user))\n659\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n660\t        request, \"admin/setup.html\",\n661\t        {\"title\": \"首次登录设置\", \"user\": user, \"display_name\": \"\"})\n662\t\n663\t\n664\t@router.post(\"/admin/setup\")\n665\tdef setup(request: Request,\n666\t          user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)],\n667\t          display_name: Annotated[str, Form()], password: Annotated[str, Form()],\n668\t          password_confirm: Annotated[str, Form()]):\n669\t    if not user.needs_setup:\n670\t        return redirect(home_for(user))\n671\t    try:\n672\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n673\t            accounts.complete_setup(conn, user, display_name=display_name,\n674\t                                    password=password,\n675\t                                    password_confirm=password_confirm)\n676\t    except accounts.Refused app/db.py\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n=== app/web.py\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"只有管理员可以使用此页面。\", status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n=== app/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? WHERE email = ?\",\n                 (state, _normalise_email(email)))\n\n\ndef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n    if not session_id:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n=== app/game.py\n\"\"\"The game: Game Terms (so far only Heroes) and Patches.\n\nA Hero is a Game Term with an official Chinese and an official English name.\nIts URL slug is derived from the English Official name.\n\nA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\nPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Patch:\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    is_current: bool\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Hero:\n    id: int\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    slug: str\n\n\ndef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"])\n\n\ndef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n                            name_en: str, hero_id: int | None = None\n                            ) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n    either name is missing or another Hero already has that slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n    if not name_zh:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n    if not name_en:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n    slug = slugify(name_en)\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n    clash = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms\"\n        \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n        (slug, hero_id)).fetchone()\n    if clash:\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n\n\ndef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> Hero:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the slug is taken.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug)\"\n        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?)\", (name_zh, name_en, slug))\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n              name_en: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug follows the English name.\n    Raises Refused as add_hero does.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en, hero_id)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, slug = ?\"\n                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, slug, hero_id))\n\n\ndef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n    name = name.strip()\n    if not name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n\n\ndef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(game.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/settings.py\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n\n\ndef database_path() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Read on every connect, so tests can point CMS_DATABASE at a temp file.\"\"\"\n    return Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\n=== app/publish.py\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n            home_path=\"index.html\",\n        )\n    )\n    return out\n=== app/routes/__init__.py\n=== app/routes/auth.py\n\"\"\"Login, logout, and first-login setup.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, db\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import (flash, home_for, redirect, signed_in_user_mid_setup,\n                     start_session, templates)\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/login.html\",\n                                      {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": \"\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login(request: Request, email: Annotated[str, Form()],\n          password: Annotated[str, Form()]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            session_id, user = accounts.log_in(conn, email, password)\n    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": email, \"error\": refused.message},\n            status_code=403 if isinstance(refused, accounts.AccountDeactivated)\n            else 401)\n    start_session(request, session_id)\n    return redirect(home_for(user))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.log_out(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    request.session.clear()\n    flash(request, \"已退出登录。\")\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/setup\")\ndef setup_form(request: Request,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)]):\n    if not user.needs_setup:\n        return redirect(home_for(user))\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/setup.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"首次登录设置\", \"user\": user, \"display_name\": \"\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/setup\")\ndef setup(request: Request,\n          user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)],\n          display_name: Annotated[str, Form()], password: Annotated[str, Form()],\n          password_confirm: Annotated[str, Form()]):\n    if not user.needs_setup:\n        return redirect(home_for(user))\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            accounts.complete_setup(conn, user, display_name=display_name,\n                                    password=password,\n                                    password_confirm=password_confirm)\n    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/setup.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"首次登录设置\", \"user\": user, \"display_name\": display_name,\n             \"error\": refused.message},\n            status_code=400)\n    flash(request, \"设置完成，欢迎加入！\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n=== app/routes/dashboard.py\n\"\"\"The console dashboard. /admin itself stays the T00 hello page.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\",\n                                      {\"title\": \"控制台\", \"user\": user})\n=== app/routes/game.py\n\"\"\"Heroes and Patches, managed by Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to; each\nroute's own `admin_user` is the same (cached) check, there to get the user.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import admin_user, flash, redirect, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(admin_user)])\n\n\ndef hero_list_page(request: Request, user: User, *, name_zh: str = \"\",\n                   name_en: str = \"\", error: str | None = None):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/heroes.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"英雄\", \"user\": user, \"heroes\": heroes, \"name_zh\": name_zh,\n         \"name_en\": name_en, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=400 if error else 200)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/heroes\")\ndef hero_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)]):\n    return hero_list_page(request, user)\n\n\n# Form fields default to \"\" so a blank field gets our message, not a 422.\n@router.post(\"/admin/heroes\")\ndef add_hero(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n             name_zh: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n             name_en: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\"):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            hero = game.add_hero(conn, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    except game.Refused as refused:\n        return hero_list_page(request, user, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en,\n                              error=refused.message)\n    flash(request, f\"已添加英雄：{hero.name_zh}（{hero.name_en}）。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/heroes\")\n\n\ndef existing_hero(hero_id: int) -> game.Hero:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        hero = game.hero(conn, hero_id)\n    if hero is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return hero\n\n\ndef hero_edit_page(request: Request, user: User, hero: game.Hero, *,\n                   name_zh: str, name_en: str, error: str | None = None):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/hero_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"编辑英雄：{hero.name_zh}\", \"user\": user, \"hero\": hero,\n         \"name_zh\": name_zh, \"name_en\": name_en, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=400 if error else 200)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/heroes/{hero_id}/edit\")\ndef hero_edit_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n                   hero: Annotated[game.Hero, Depends(existing_hero)]):\n    return hero_edit_page(request, user, hero, name_zh=hero.name_zh,\n                          name_en=hero.name_en)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/heroes/{hero_id}\")\ndef edit_hero(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n              hero: Annotated[game.Hero, Depends(existing_hero)],\n              name_zh: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n              name_en: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\"):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            game.edit_hero(conn, hero.id, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    except game.Refused as refused:\n        return hero_edit_page(request, user, hero, name_zh=name_zh,\n                              name_en=name_en, error=refused.message)\n    flash(request, \"已保存英雄的官方名称。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/heroes\")\n\n\ndef patch_list_page(request: Request, user: User, *, name: str = \"\",\n                    error: str | None = None):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/patches.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"版本\", \"user\": user, \"patches\": patches, \"name\": name,\n         \"error\": error},\n Domain Docs\n\nHow the engineering skills should consume this repo's domain documentation when exploring the codebase.\n\n## Before exploring, read these\n\n- **`CONTEXT.md`** at the repo root, or\n- **`CONTEXT-MAP.md`** at the repo root if it exists: it points at one `CONTEXT.md` per context. Read each one relevant to the topic.\n- **`docs/adr/`**: read ADRs that touch the area you're about to work in. In multi-context repos, also check `src/<context>/docs/adr/` for context-scoped decisions.\n\nIf any of these files don't exist, **proceed silently**. Don't flag their absence; don't suggest creating them upfront. The `/domain-modeling` skill (reached via `/grill-with-docs` and `/improve-codebase-architecture`) creates them lazily when terms or decisions actually get resolved.\n\n## File structure\n\nSingle-context repo (most repos):\n\n```\n/\n├── CONTEXT.md\n├── docs/adr/\n│   ├── 0001-event-sourced-orders.md\n│   └── 0002-postgres-for-write-model.md\n└── src/\n```\n\nMulti-context repo (presence of `CONTEXT-MAP.md` at the root):\n\n```\n/\n├── CONTEXT-MAP.md\nADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md  1.4K\nADR-002-stack.md  1.1K","is_error":false},{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_01CjnRHFoG74eekTqBaVP8gm","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"5c9d30c0-b58a-42d4-9bb2-2f007687eab9","timestamp":"2026-10-17T12:42:57.148Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01CjnRHFoG74eekTqBaVP8gm","session_id":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

the seed script creates one Admin and one Editor from the environment.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom conftest import DEMO_USERS, login\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef run_seed(env: dict[str, str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    clean = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()\n             if k not in (\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")}\n    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/seed_demo.py\"], cwd=ROOT,\n                          env=clean | env, capture_output=True, text=True)\n\n\ndef test_seed_refuses_to_run_without_both_passwords(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    seeded_db = tmp_path / \"seeded.db\"\n    result = run_seed({\"CMS_DATABASE\": str(seeded_db),\n                       \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\": \"only-the-admin-pw\"})\n    assert result.returncode != 0\n    assert \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\" in result.stdout + result.stderr\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(seeded_db))\n    c = TestClient(create_app())\n    assert login(c, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], \"only-the-admin-pw\").status_code == 401\n\n\ndef test_seeded_admin_and_editor_log_in_with_the_passwords_from_the_environment(\n        tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    seeded_db = tmp_path / \"seeded.db\"\n    result = run_seed({\"CMS_DATABASE\": str(seeded_db),\n                       \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\": \"from-env-admin\",\n                       \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\": \"from-env-editor\"})\n    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    assert \"from-env\" not in result.stdout + result.stderr\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(seeded_db))\n    for role, password in [(\"admin\", \"from-env-admin\"), (\"editor\", \"from-env-editor\")]:\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        response = login(c, DEMO_USERS[role][\"email\"], password)\n        assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/dashboard\"\n        assert DEMO_USERS[role][\"display_name\"] in c.get(\"/admin/dashboard\").text\n\n\ndef test_seeding_twice_is_harmless(tmp_path):\n    env = {\"CMS_DATABASE\": str(tmp_path / \"seeded.db\"),\n           \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\": \"from-env-admin\",\n           \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\": \"from-env-editor\"}\n    assert run_seed(env).returncode == 0\n    assert run_seed(env).returncode == 0\n\"\"\"T00: the walking skeleton. These pass in the fresh template.\n\nDo not delete them. If a change breaks them, the change broke the app's front\ndoor.\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_console_answers(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"hello admin\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_public_home_answers(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_a_site(tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists() and (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_published_html_uses_relative_paths(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Root-absolute paths break on GitHub Pages project URLs (rubric F2).\"\"\"\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    html = (render_site(tmp_path / \"site\") / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in html\n# ADR-001: The admin console runs locally; the public site is a static export\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nA CMS needs a server, a database, and login. GitHub Pages serves static files\nonly: it cannot run Python and has no database. Students have two weeks and no\nhosting budget, and a first web application with real authentication is an\nattractive target the moment it is public.\n\n## Decision\n\nThe admin console (FastAPI + SQLite) runs on the student's own machine. A\n`cms publish` step renders the published content to static HTML in `site/`, which\nis deployed to GitHub Pages on the `gh-pages` branch.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Login, roles, and the database are never exposed to the internet.\n- The public site cannot have server-side features (search, comments) without a\n  different host; a stretch goal may add a live admin deploy behind a security gate.\n- Publishing is explicit: content changes are not live until `cms publish` runs,\n  which is a behaviour worth documenting for your client.\n- Relative paths become mandatory, because Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n\n## Why this is an ADR\n\nIt is hard to reverse (it shapes every route, template, and deploy step) and it\nis surprising without context (most CMSes are servers). That is the bar; most\ndecisions do not meet it and belong in the spec or the glossary instead.\n# ADR-002: FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, with no frontend framework\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nThe project has to be readable by someone who has never built a web application,\ngradable from a clean clone, and finishable in two weeks on a $20 plan. Options\nconsidered: Django (batteries included, but a large amount of generated code to\nread), Flask (similar to FastAPI here), a JavaScript stack (a second language and\na build step), and FastAPI with server-rendered templates.\n\n## Decision\n\nFastAPI with Jinja2 templates, SQLite for storage, argon2 for password hashing,\nand an HTML sanitizer for user Markdown. No frontend framework, no build step.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Every page is server-rendered, so \"view source\" shows what the code produced,\n  which makes debugging visible.\n- SQLite is a single file, so a grader can seed and inspect it easily. It is\n  gitignored; `scripts/seed_demo.py` rebuilds it.\n- No build step means the file you preview is the file that ships.\n- Interactive flourishes (live preview without reload, drag-and-drop) cost more\n  here than in a JavaScript stack. That is an accepted trade.\ndef test_signed_out_console_pages_redirect_to_login(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/dashboard\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n    assert \"你好\" not in response.text\n\n\ndef test_login_without_a_csrf_token_is_rejected(client):\n    client.get(\"/login\")\n    user = DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"]\n    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": user[\"email\"],\n                                           \"password\": user[\"password\"]},\n                           follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/dashboard\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_logout_with_a_missing_or_wrong_csrf_token_is_rejected(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.post(\"/logout\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 403\n    assert admin.post(\"/logout\", data={\"csrf_token\": \"forged\"},\n                      follow_redirects=False).status_code == 403\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin/dashboard\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_deactivated_editor_cannot_log_in_and_is_told_why(client):\n    add_user(email=\"gone@example.test\", password=\"gone-pw-123\", role=\"editor\",\n             display_name=\"离开的编辑\", state=\"deactivated\")\n\n    response = login(client, \"gone@example.test\", \"gone-pw-123\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert \"账号已停用\" in response.text\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/dashboard\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_deactivated_account_with_a_wrong_password_gets_the_usual_refusal(client):\n \"wrong-pw\")\n    assert response.status_code == 401\n    assert \"邮箱或密码错误\" in response.text and \"账号已停用\" not in response.text\n\n\ndef new_editor_needing_setup():\n    add_user(email=\"new@example.test\", password=\"temporary-pw\", role=\"editor\",\n             needs_setup=True)\n\n\ndef submit_setup(c: TestClient, display_name: str, password: str,\n                 password_confirm: str | None = None):\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(\"/admin/setup\").text)\n    return c.post(\"/admin/setup\", data={\n        \"csrf_token\": token, \"display_name\": display_name, \"password\": password,\n        \"password_confirm\": password if password_confirm is None else password_confirm,\n    }, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_editor_flagged_for_first_login_setup_must_finish_it_before_any_console_page(client):\n    new_editor_needing_setup()\n    response = login(client, \"new@example.test\", \"temporary-pw\")\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/setup\"\n\n    blocked = client.get(\"/admin/dashboard\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert blocked.status_code == 303 and blocked.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/setup\"\n    setup_page = client.get(\"/admin/setup\")\n    assert setup_page.status_code == 200 and \"设置\" in setup_page.text\n\n\ndef test_finishing_setup_sets_the_display_name_and_replaces_the_temporary_password(client):\n    new_editor_needing_setup()\n    login(client, \"new@example.test\", \"temporary-pw\")\n\n    response = submit_setup(client, \"新来的up主\", \"my-own-password\")\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/dashboard\"\n    dashboard = client.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n    assert \"你好，新来的up主\" in {"parentUuid":"157058ce-0b66-4bdb-9466-7f28d4d86b53","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg7qAHVQ7K4R64o1vZ9AP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018ZJGs3RRSmxBMqwWHyaovK","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t03_guides.py","content":"\"\"\"T03: Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\n\n\ndef submit(c: TestClient, form_page: str, action: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the form on `form_page` the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(form_page).text)\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": token, **fields},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"An Admin, with Heroes and Patches 6.4 to 6.7 (6.7 current) in place.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for name_zh, name_en in [(\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\"), (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\")]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n               name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n    return admin\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(admin, client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\ndef option_value(page: str, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the <option> showing `label` on a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<option value=\"(\\d+)\"[^>]*>{re.escape(label)}</option>', page)\n    assert match, f\"no option labelled {label}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef hero_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef patch_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef guide_fields(c: TestClient, **fields) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A complete Guide form: Chinese text, Vanessa, the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    defaults = {\"title_zh\": \"瓦妮莎海盗流\", \"body_zh\": \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船。\",\n                \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\",\n                \"hero_id\": hero_id(c, \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"),\n                \"patch_id\": patch_id(c, \"6.7（当前版本）\")}\n    return defaults | fields\n\n\ndef new_guide(c: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = submit(c, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",\n                      **guide_fields(c, **fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/guides/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, **fields):\n    form = c.get(edit_page).text\n    current = {name: value for name, value in\n               re.findall(r'<input type=\"text\" name=\"(\\w+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', form)}\n    return submit(c, edit_page, edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\"),\n                  **guide_fields(c, **current, **fields))\n\n\ndef test_editor_saves_a_draft_and_edits_it_later(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\",\n                          body_zh=\"先拿船，再拿炮。\")\n    page = editor.get(edit_page)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"草稿已保存\" in page.text\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\"' in page.text and \"先拿船，再拿炮。\" in page.text\n\n    response = save(editor, edit_page, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\"' in editor.get(edit_page).text\n\n    listing = editor.get(\"/admin/guides\").text\n    assert \"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\" in listing and \"草稿\" in listing\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":148,"cache_read_input_tokens":104290,"output_tokens":1731,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":92},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":148,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1731,"cache_read_input_tokens":104290,"cache_creation_input_tokens":148,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":148},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_018ZJGs3RRSmxBMqwWHyaovK":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t03_guides.py","content":"\"\"\"T03: Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them (Seam 1: the\nconsole over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\n\n\ndef submit(c: TestClient, form_page: str, action: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the form on `form_page` the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(form_page).text)\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": token, **fields},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"An Admin, with Heroes and Patches 6.4 to 6.7 (6.7 current) in place.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for name_zh, name_en in [(\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\"), (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\")]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n               name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n    return admin\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(admin, client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\ndef option_value(page: str, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the <option> showing `label` on a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<option value=\"(\\d+)\"[^>]*>{re.escape(label)}</option>', page)\n    assert match, f\"no option labelled {label}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef hero_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef patch_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef guide_fields(c: TestClient, **fields) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A complete Guide form: Chinese text, Vanessa, the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    defaults = {\"title_zh\": \"瓦妮莎海盗流\", \"body_zh\": \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船。\",\n                \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\",\n                \"hero_id\": hero_id(c, \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"),\n                \"patch_id\": patch_id(c, \"6.7（当前版本）\")}\n    return defaults | fields\n\n\ndef new_guide(c: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = submit(c, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",\n                      **guide_fields(c, **fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/guides/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, **fields):\n    form = c.get(edit_page).text\n    current = {name: value for name, value in\n               re.findall(r'<input type=\"text\" name=\"(\\w+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', form)}\n    return submit(c, edit_page, edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\"),\n                  **guide_fields(c, **current, **fields))\n\n\ndef test_editor_saves_a_draft_and_edits_it_later(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\",\n                          body_zh=\"先拿船，再拿炮。\")\n    page = editor.get(edit_page)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"草稿已保存\" in page.text\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\"' in page.text and \"先拿船，再拿炮。\" in page.text\n\n    response = save(editor, edit_page, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\"' in editor.get(edit_page).text\n\n    listing = editor.get(\"/admin/guides\").text\n    assert \"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\" in listing and \"草稿\" in listing\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6149a509-e58c-43d4-829f-eee7a56e7e87","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n    return admin\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef hero_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef patch_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef guide_fields(c: TestClient, **fields) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A complete Guide form: Chinese text, Vanessa, the Current (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block
