Code asks `user.can(...)`, never which\n# role someone has, so a rule can move between roles without touching callers.\nCAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"admin\": frozenset({\n        \"publish_guides\",      # Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts\n        \"manage_all_guides\",   # see and edit everyone's Guides, any Hero\n        \"edit_guide_slugs\",\n    }),\n    \"editor\": frozenset(),\n}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n    def can(self, capability: str) -> bool:\n        return capability in CAPABILITIES[self.role]\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? {"parentUuid":"c5bd3df9-6a55-43f9-8794-c59872ce1a65","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg7qDBpR3vPEBbuUznhsw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018jPaL7yFuSQNkxN8GGjp5e","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/guides.py","content":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. Routes never touch a Guide's\nrow themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it either\nmakes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import game\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    return Guide(**{field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__})\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? dataclass\n\nfrom app import game\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: {"parentUuid":"e372a0f6-5d59-4ba5-a08f-da9be791a6ba","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e7da3d56-78a0-4f9b-be92-d33c15814679","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01N3E4e8ou2ArJGtX82jKJ6q","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/guides.py has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"9db27794-3640-4948-8f25-5d9507494a6f","timestamp":"2026-10-17T12:46:22.883Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/guides.py","oldString":"    if not any(patch.id == fields.patch_id for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, fields.patch_id  # type: ignore[return-value]  # checked above","newString":"    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id","originalFile":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. Routes never touch a Guide's\nrow themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it either\nmakes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import game\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    return Guide(**{field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__})\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see, most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        params).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    if not any(patch.id == fields.patch_id for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, fields.patch_id  # type: ignore[return-value]  # checked above\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                 (f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        \" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":140,"oldLines":9,"newStart":140,"newLines":11,"lines":["     hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None","     if hero is None:","         raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")","-    if not any(patch.id == fields.patch_id for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):","+    patch_id = fields.patch_id","+    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id","+                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):","         raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")","-    return hero, fields.patch_id  # type: ignore[return-value]  # checked above","+    return hero, patch_id"," "," "," def create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e372a0f6-5d59-4ba5-a08f-da9be791a6ba","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"guide\": guide, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": with db.connect() as conn:\n        guide = guides.guide(conn, user, guide_id)\n    if guide is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, fields {\"title\": \"攻略\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/new\")\ndef new_guide_form(request: Request,\n                   user: Annotated[User, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.create(conn, user, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return body_zh=body_zh, title_en=title_en,\n                       body_en=body_en, hero_id=_id_or_none(hero_id),\n                       patch_id=_id_or_none(patch_id), slug=slug)\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: guides.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, guides.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, guide: Guide | None,\n                fields: GuideFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn, guide)\n    title = f\"编辑攻略：{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if guide else \"写攻略\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guide_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"guide\": guide, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"heroes\": heroes, \"patches\": patches, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef refused_page(request: Request, user: User, guide_id: int,\n                 fields: GuideFields | None, refused: guides.Refused):\n    \"\"\"Show the editor again with the reason, keeping what was typed.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(refused, guides.GuideNotFound):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        guide = guides.guide(conn, user, guide_id)\n    if guide is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, fields or GuideFields.of(guide),\n                       error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef guide_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.guides(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/guides.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"攻略\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/new\")\ndef new_guide_form(request: Request,\n                   user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = guides.patch_choices(conn)\n    current = patches[0].id if patches else None\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, GuideFields(patch_id=current))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides\")\ndef create_guide(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                 fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.create(conn, user, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                    guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, GuideFields.of(guide))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}\")\ndef save_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n               fields: Annotated[GuideFields, Depends(guide_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.save(conn, user, guide_id, fields)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, fields, refused)\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\")\n    return   · 更新于 {{ guide.updated_at }}</p>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ '/admin/guides/%d' % guide.id if guide else '/admin/guides' }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" <option value=\"{{ hero.id }}\"{% if hero.id == fields.hero_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ hero.name_zh }}（{{ hero.name_en }}）</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>版本\n      <select name=\"patch_id\" required>\n        {% for patch in patches %}\n        <option value=\"{{ patch.id }}\"{% if patch.id == fields.patch_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ patch.name }}{% if patch.is_current %}（当前版本）{% endif %}</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>中文版（提交审核前必须填写）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title_zh\" value=\"{{ fields.title_zh }}\">\n      </label>\n      <label>正文（Markdown）\n        <textarea name=\"body_zh\" rows=\"16\">{{ fields.body_zh }}</textarea>\n      </label>\n    </fieldset>\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>英文版（可选）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title_en\" value=\"{{ fields.title_en }}\">\n      </label>\n      <label>正文（Markdown）\n        <textarea name=\"body_en\" rows=\"16\">{{ fields.body_en }}</textarea>\n      </label>\n    </fieldset>\n\n    <button type=\"submit\">{{ \"保存\" if guide and guide.status 6.4 is never offered, so its id is the one after 6.7's minus three.","+    too_old = str(int(patch_id(editor, \"6.7（当前版本）\")) - 3)","+    response = submit(editor, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",","+                      **guide_fields(editor, patch_id=too_old))","+    assert response.status_code == 400","+    assert \"请选择版本\" in response.text","+","+","+def test_a_guide_keeps_its_older_patch_after_new_patches_arrive(editor, admin):","+    edit_page = new_guide(editor, patch_id=patch_id(editor, \"6.5\"))","+    for name in [\"6.8\", \"6.9\"]:","+        submit(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)","+","+    page = editor.get(edit_page).text","+    assert options(page, \"patch_id\") == [\"6.9（当前版本）\", \"6.8\", \"6.7\", \"6.5\"]","+    assert save(editor, edit_page, title_zh=\"改个标题\").status_code == 303","+    assert options(editor.get(edit_page).text, \"patch_id\")[-1] == \"6.5\"","+","+","+def test_a_guide_must_have_a_hero(editor):","+    response = submit(editor, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",","+                      **guide_fields(editor, hero_id=\"\"))","+    assert response.status_code == 400","+    assert \"请选择英雄\" in response.text","+    assert \"没有攻略\" in editor.get(\"/admin/guides\").text"]}]}],"moreFiles":0,"changedFiles":["/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t03_guides.py"]}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f1b1c3ed-1b96-468d-ad46-4b412f182381","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

`form_page` the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(form_page).text)\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": token, **fields},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"An Admin, with Heroes and Patches 6.4 to 6.7 (6.7 current) in place.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for name_zh, name_en in [(\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\"), (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\")]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n               name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n    for name in [\"6.4\", \"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n    return admin\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(admin, client_as) -> TestClient:\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\ndef option_value(page: str, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the <option> showing `label` on a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<option value=\"(\\d+)\"[^>]*>{re.escape(label)}</option>', page)\n    assert match, f\"no option labelled {label}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef hero_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef patch_id(c: TestClient, label: str) -> str:\n    return option_value(c.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text, label)\n\n\ndef guide_fields(c: TestClient, **fields) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"A complete Guide form: Chinese text, Vanessa, the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    defaults = {\"title_zh\": \"瓦妮莎海盗流\", \"body_zh\": \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n先拿船。\",\n                \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\",\n                \"hero_id\": hero_id(c, \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"),\n                \"patch_id\": patch_id(c, \"6.7（当前版本）\")}\n    return defaults | fields\n\n\ndef new_guide(c: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = submit(c, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",\n                      **guide_fields(c, **fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/guides/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef form_values(page: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form on `page` would send unchanged: its text inputs,\n    textareas and selected options.\"\"\"\n    values = dict(re.findall(r'<input type=\"text\" name=\"(\\w+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page))\n    values |= dict(re.findall(r'<textarea name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>', page,\n                              re.DOTALL))\n    for name, options in re.findall(r'<select name=\"(\\w+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</select>', page,\n                                    re.DOTALL):\n        selected = re.search(r'<option value=\"(\\d*)\" selected', options)\n        values[name] = selected.group(1) if selected else \"\"\n    return {name: html.unescape(value) for name, value in values.items()}\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, edit_page: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Change some fields of a saved Guide, keeping the rest as they are.\"\"\"\n    current = form_values(c.get(edit_page).text)\n    return submit(c, edit_page, edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\"),\n                  **(current | fields))\n\n\ndef test_editor_saves_a_draft_and_edits_it_later(editor):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\",\n                          body_zh=\"先拿船，再拿炮。\")\n    page = editor.get(edit_page)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"草稿已保存\" in page.text\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\"' in page.text and \"先拿船，再拿炮。\" in page.text\n\n    response = save(editor, edit_page, title_zh=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\"' in editor.get(edit_page).text\n\n    listing = editor.get(\"/admin/guides\").text\n    assert \"瓦妮莎海盗流（修改版）\" in listing and \"草稿\" in listing\n\n\ndef options(page: str, select: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The labels of the options in the <select> called `select`.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<select name=\"{select}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</select>', page, re.DOTALL)\n    assert match, f\"no {select} picker\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<option[^>]*>([^<]*)</option>\", match.group(1))\n\n\ndef test_hero_picker_lists_official_names_only(editor):\n    page = editor.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text\n    assert options(page, \"hero_id\") == [\"请选择英雄\", \"杜利（Dooley）\", \"瓦妮莎（Vanessa）\"]\n\n\ndef test_patch_picker_offers_the_current_patch_preselected_and_the_two_before(editor):\n    page = editor.get(\"/admin/guides/new\").text\n    assert options(page, \"patch_id\") == [\"6.7（当前版本）\", \"6.6\", \"6.5\"]\n    assert form_values(page)[\"patch_id\"] == patch_id(editor, \"6.7（当前版本）\")\n\n\ndef test_a_patch_older_than_the_choices_is_refused_for_a_new_guide(editor, admin):\n    old_patch = re.search(r\"<td>6.4</td>\", admin.get(\"/admin/patches\").text)\n    assert old_patch\n    # 6.4 is never offered, so its id is the one after 6.7's minus three.\n    too_old = str(int(patch_id(editor, \"6.7（当前版本）\")) - 3)\n    response = submit(editor, \"/admin/guides/new\", \"/admin/guides\",\n                      **guide_fields(editor, patch_id=too_old))\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"请选择版本\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_a_guide_keeps_its_older_patch_after_new_patches_arrive(editor, admin):\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor, patch_id=patch_id(editor, \"6.5\"))\n    for name in [\"6.8\", \"6.9\"]:\n        submit(admin, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n\n    page = editor.get(edit_page).text\n    assert options(page, \"patch_id\") == [\"6.9（当前版本）\", \"6.8\", \"6.7\", \"6.5\"]\n    assert save(editor, edit_page, title_zh=\"改个标题\").status_code == 303\n    assert options(editor.get(edit_page).text, \"patch_id\")[-1] == \"6.5\"\n\n\ndef test_a_guide_must_have_a_hero(editor):\n AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        \" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)","originalFile":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. Routes never touch a Guide's\nrow themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it either\nmakes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import game\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    return Guide(**{field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__})\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see, most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        params).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if Routes never touch a Guide's\nrow themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it either\nmakes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import game\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    return Guide(**{field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__})\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see, most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        params).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                 (f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n        return current.slug\n    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        \" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":13,"oldLines":6,"newStart":13,"newLines":7,"lines":[" \"\"\""," from __future__ import annotations"," ","+import re"," import sqlite3"," from dataclasses import dataclass"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e38c6036-bc8c-49af-a4e5-a6d2c43ec378","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                    guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, guide, WHERE id = ?\", (slug, guide_id))","originalFile":"\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. Routes never touch a Guide's\nrow themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it either\nmakes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import game\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide, or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这篇攻略。\")\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    return Guide(**{field: row[field] for field in Guide.__dataclass_fields__})\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return \"1\", ()\n    return \"guides.author_id = ?\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see, most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {where}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        params).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two\n    before it, plus the Guide's own Patch if that is older still.\"\"\"\n    patches = game.patches(conn)\n    choices = patches[:3]\n    if guide and all(patch.id != guide.patch_id for patch in choices):\n        choices += [patch for patch in patches if patch.id == guide.patch_id]\n    return choices\n\n\ndef _checked_hero_and_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: GuideFields,\n                            guide: Guide | None = None) -> tuple[game.Hero, int]:\n    hero = game.hero(conn, fields.hero_id) if fields.hero_id else None\n    if hero is None:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择英雄。\")\n    patch_id = fields.patch_id\n    if patch_id is None or all(patch.id != patch_id\n                               for patch in patch_choices(conn, guide)):\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    return hero, patch_id\n\n\ndef create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Guide as a Draft by `actor`, who becomes its Author.\"\"\"\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO guides (title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en, hero_id,\"\n        \" patch_id, author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))\n    guide_id = cur.lastrowid\n    assert guide_id is not None\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                 (f\"{hero.slug}-{guide_id}\", guide_id))\n    new = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    assert new is not None\n    return new\n\n\ndef _editable(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    found = guide(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if found is None:\n        raise GuideNotFound\n    return found\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, current: Guide,\n                  slug: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug to keep: the current one unless an Admin typed another.\"\"\"\n    if slug is None or slug.strip() == current.slug:\n        return current.slug\n    if not actor.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以修改网址名。\")\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 vanessa-12。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM guides WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                    (slug, current.id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一篇攻略使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef save(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int,\n         fields: GuideFields) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"Save changes to a Guide without changing its status.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    hero, patch_id = _checked_hero_and_patch(conn, fields, current)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, actor, current, fields.slug)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE guides SET title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?, body_en = ?,\"\n        \" hero_id = ?, patch_id = ?, slug = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\"\n        \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.title_zh.strip(), fields.body_zh, fields.title_en.strip(),\n         fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, slug, guide_id))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":158,"oldLines":8,"newStart":158,"newLines":12,"lines":["          fields.body_en, hero.id, patch_id, actor.id))","     guide_id = cur.lastrowid","     assert guide_id is not None","-    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET slug = ?  author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor:                       (\"guides.author_id\", only.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", only.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = only.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","hash":"46e529f1f1b8f992fc525f565b255a1d6a3794a6f45368d77406b5fc1236f2d9","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_012ZaMfHLdQfGQafBcUHTXAq","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:code-review"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If not, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in the tracker doc.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nSearch the repo for every file that documents how code should be written. When `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists, it must be on the list.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\nIssue both sub-agent calls together, in the foreground, and aggregate the reports they return.\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted changes since HEAD (903db8c) for ticket #4 (T03). Spec is issue #1."}]}}

{"parentUuid":"bacc78b0-b531-4752-8ca5-a425d6f41ff9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e7da3d56-78a0-4f9b-be92-d33c15814679","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If not, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in the tracker doc.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nSearch the repo for every file that documents how code should be written. When `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists, it must be on the list.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\nIssue both sub-agent calls together, in the foreground, and aggregate the reports they return.\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted changes since HEAD (903db8c) for ticket #4 (T03). Spec is issue #1."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"cb6ecfe5-5721-46ab-901b-83f58a763769","timestamp":"2026-10-17T12:55:53.664Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_012ZaMfHLdQfGQafBcUHTXAq","session_id":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>I found no hard breaches of the documented standards in T03. CSRF is enforced app-wide, Markdown is sanitized, and no dependency was added. The real gaps are one glossary update and some judgement calls.\n\n**Standards compliance:**\n- **CSRF:** every new POST form carries `csrf_token`, and `app/main.py:19` checks it on every route with `Depends(web.verify_csrf)`. The 提交审核 and 发布 buttons use `formaction` inside the same form, so they send the token too.\n- **Sanitized Markdown:** `app/rendering.py` passes the output through `nh3.clean`, and the preview uses `| safe` only on that cleaned result.\n- **Dependencies:** `nh3` and `markdown-it-py` are already in `pyproject.toml`.\n- **Relative paths:** the `/admin/...` links are console-only, not published HTML, so that rule doesn't apply.\n\n**Documented-standard gaps (soft):**\n1. **CONTEXT.md is out of date** (CLAUDE.md: \"update the glossary rather than using both\"). Its **Slug** entry covers Heroes only and says a slug \"follows the English name\". Guide slugs (`app/guides.py:7-9`) never change on their own. Either the Slug entry should cover both, or Guide slugs need their own term.\n2. **Tests depend on internal row ids** (spec Testing Decisions: \"never inspect database rows\"). Examples are `str(int(patch_id(...)) - 3)`, `int(first.split(\"/\")[3]) + 1` and `\"?author=1\"  # 1 is the Admin` in `tests/test_t03_guides.py`. They don't read rows, but they guess the database's id numbering.\n3. **Mixed role checks.** The new comment in `app/accounts.py` says code \"asks `user.can(...)`, never which role someone has\". But `templates/admin/base.html:38` (in a file this diff touches) still checks `user.role == \"admin\"`.\n\n**Baseline smells (judgement calls):**\n- **Duplicated Code**\n  - The test helper `submit` is copied word for word from `tests/test_t02_heroes_patches.py`.\n  - The status-count regex appears in both `dashboard_counts` (test_t03_guides) and `counts` (test_t03_seed).\n  - `hero_id` and `patch_id` in the tests have identical bodies.\n  - In `app/routes/guides.py`, the \"look up the Guide or return 404\" code appears in both `refused_page` and `visible_guide`.\n- **Mysterious Name:** the test helper `submit` posts any form, but in this file \"Submit\" is a step in the Guide workflow. That's confusing next to `act(..., \"submit\")`. The `only` parameter (the filter) and the untyped `step` parameter are also unclear.\n- **Data Clumps**\n  - `title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en` appear together in `Guide`, `GuideFields`, both SQL statements, and the `DEMO_GUIDES` tuples. CONTEXT.md's \"Chinese text / English text\" (title plus body) suggests one small type for them.\n  - `(request, user, guide_id, fields)` is passed through `workflow_step`, `refused_page` and `editor_page`.\n- **Primitive Obsession / Repeated Switches**\n  - Plain strings `\"draft\"`, `\"submitted\"` and `\"published\"` are compared all through `guides.py`, `seed_demo.py` and `guide_edit.html`.\n  - Capabilities are also plain strings, so a typo in `can(\"manage_all_guide\")` quietly returns False.\n  - `actor.state == \"submission_ban\"` is another raw string.\n- **Speculative Generality:** the `CAPABILITIES` map has three capabilities, all Admin-only, plus an empty set for Editors. All 13 acceptance criteria of #4 are implemented, and the T03 tests pass (46 passed). The findings below are minor.\n\n**(a) Missing or partial**\n\n1. Spec: \"The Markdown editor has a preview that shows the Guide as Readers will see it.\" The preview is a separate GET page that renders only the *saved* text (`app/routes/guides.py` `preview_guide`, and the template itself says \"显示已保存的内容\"). To preview new text, an Editor has to save first. That meets the ticket, but it is not a live editor preview.\n2. Ticket: \"nothing in the Editor's views offers 发布.\" The test only checks `&lt;button&gt;` text. Editor pages still show the status label 已发布 (dashboard, list filter) and the refusal text 只有管理员可以发布攻略. These are labels, not offers, so it is defensible, but the test is narrower than the wording.\n\n**(b) Not asked for (scope creep)**\n\n1. **Submission ban check** in `guides.submit` (`actor.state == \"submission_ban\"`). Spec: \"Submit … is refused under a Submission ban.\" That belongs to the later user-management ticket. It is harmless, but it has no UI or test here, and the later ticket should take it over rather than add a second check.\n2. **English both-or-neither rule** in `_check_text`: Submit and Publish are refused if only the English title or only the English body is filled in. Spec: \"English optional.\" Nothing asks for this rule, and it blocks Submit.\n3. **Slug fallback `-&lt;id&gt;-2`** in `guides.create`, used when an Admin has already taken `&lt;hero-slug&gt;-&lt;id&gt;`. Ticket: \"slug of the form `&lt;hero-slug&gt;-&lt;id&gt;`.\" It is a reasonable guard, but it produces slugs outside that form.\n\n**(c) Implemented, but may conflict later**\n\n1. Spec: \"One function used by both the editor preview and the Site build … `[[term]]` markers become the Official name in the target language … The same pass returns warnings.\" `render_markdown(text) -&gt; str` has no language parameter and no warnings in its return value. The later tickets will have to change its signature and every caller.\n2. Hard constraint: \"Published HTML uses relative paths only.\" `render_markdown` passes nh3's defaults, which allow `src=\"/...\"` and `href=\"/...\"` written by users. That doesn't matter yet, but it will once this function feeds the Site build.\n3. Spec: \"'In Trash' is separate from status\" and \"A Revision is a pending copy\". The `guides` table has no trash flag and no cover image yet. That is fine for T03, but `_visible_to`, `guides()` and `counts()` hard-code their WHERE clauses. The Trash ticket must add its filter in all three, or trashed Guides will still show in counts and lists.\n4. `save` refuses an Editor's edit to a Published Guide with \"已发布的攻略要通过修订来修改\", which correctly anticipates Revisions. Admins edit Published Guides directly, which matches \"Admin edits to a Published Guide apply directly with no Revision.\"\n\nThings that look correct: CSRF (global dependency), 404 for other people's Guides, Publish refused on a direct POST, Patch choices (current one preselected and older Patches kept), Hero changes leaving the slug alone, Admins changing any Hero, counts per role, and the seed covering all three statuses through the workflow module.\n\nFiles: `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/guides.py`, `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/rendering.py`, `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/routes/guides.py`</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>70867</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>8</tool_uses><duration_ms>90782</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

{"parentUuid":"a007ed52-1776-4c62-8226-08033b8be011","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg7rGGbMvF94LzeFFG6yQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Same 103 passing and 14 Exercise B failures as before. Here's the aggregated review, with how I resolved each finding.\n\n## Standards\nNo hard violations. CSRF covers every new form, including the `formaction` buttons, Markdown is sanitized with nh3, and no dependency was added. Soft gaps and smells, with what I did:\n1. **CONTEXT.md out of date:** the Slug entry covered Heroes only. **Fixed:** it now covers Guide slugs too.\n2. **Tests guessing database ids** (`?author=1`, `patch_id - 3`). **Fixed:** they now read ids from the console's filter options. The slug-collision test still uses \"the next id\" on purpose, because the slug is defined by the id.\n3. **A role check left in `base.html`** while the new comment says \"never ask the role\". **Fixed:** added a `manage_game` capability, now used by `web.admin_user` and the nav.\n4. **Duplicated Code:** the test `submit` helper, `hero_id`/`patch_id`, the dashboard-count regex, and the 404 lookup. **Fixed:** the helper is reused from T02 as `fill_in`, which also clears up the clash with \"Submit\". The others are merged or shared.\n5. **Mysterious Name:** `only` and the untyped `step`. **Fixed:** `only` is now `filters`, and `step` is typed `WorkflowStep`.\n6. **Data Clumps, Primitive Obsession** (status strings), and capabilities as **Speculative Generality**. **Kept.** Status strings match the existing `state` idiom, and the spec asks for \"roles are bundles of capabilities\".\n\n## Spec\nAll 13 acceptance criteria are met.\n1. **The preview shows only saved text, not a live preview.** **Kept:** ADR-002 accepts no live preview.\n2. **The 发布 test only checks buttons.** **Kept:** 已发布 is a status label, not something an Editor can do.\n3. **Possible scope creep:** the Submission ban check, the English \"both title and body, or neither\" rule, and the `-<id>-2` slug fallback. **Kept.** The spec puts the ban check in the workflow, and it does have a test. The English rule decides what \"has English text\" means. The fallback stops a crash.\n4. **Will need work in later tickets:** `render_markdown` has no language or warnings yet, root-absolute `src`/`href` must be refused before the Site build, and Trash will need filtering. **Deferred.** The Trash filter goes in `_visible_to`, which all three queries share.\n\n**Summary:** Standards had 6 groups of findings; the worst was the out-of-date glossary (fixed). Trash will need filtering | **Deferred** to the `[[term]]`, Site build and Trash tickets. The Trash filter belongs in `_visible_to`, which the list, the counts and the single-Guide lookup all share. |\n\nTests: 103 pass, including 46 new T03 tests.
