{"parentUuid":"e7ccd6c7-5344-4950-9425-e273a437b59a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg7rKEhbKbRnYbh9DuzVC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T03 (#4, \"Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them\") is committed as `7a25866` on your branch, and all 13 acceptance criteria are met. I haven't pushed it.\n\n**Tests:** 103 pass, 46 of them new for T03. The full suite still has the same 14 failures it had before I started: the unfinished `ctx_guard` and `usage_report` exercises (MP2 Exercise B), which aren't part of this ticket. The type checker reports 0 errors.\n\n**What it does now:**\n- **Workflow:** every status change goes through one module, `app/guides.py`. It checks a capability (`user.can(...)`), never the role name, as the spec asks.\n- **Editors:** they write a Guide, save it as a Draft and submit it with 提交审核. Submit needs the Chinese title and body, and the console says why when they're missing. Editors can never Publish, even by posting to the Publish route directly. Another person's Guide simply returns \"not found\" to them.\n- **Admins:** they Publish Submitted Guides and can Publish their own Drafts without submitting. They can also change any Guide's Hero or slug.\n- **The editor form:** the Hero list shows Official names only. The Patch list shows the Current Patch (preselected and labelled current) plus the two before it, and keeps a Guide's older Patch if it has one.\n- **Slugs:** a new Guide gets `<hero-slug>-<id>`. It never changes on its own, and a duplicate is refused.\n- **Saving with the buttons:** 提交审核 and 发布 save what's in the form in the same step. If the step is refused, nothing is saved and the typed text stays on screen with the reason.\n- **Preview:** the Markdown is rendered and cleaned (scripts, `onerror` handlers and iframes are stripped), with the English version shown when there is one. It shows the saved text, not a live preview, which ADR-002 accepts.\n- **Console:** the content list filters by status, Hero, Author, Patch and language. The dashboard shows counts by status: Editors see their own, Admins see everything. The seed script adds demo Guides in all three statuses.\n\n**Things I added that the ticket didn't spell out:**\n- A Submission ban blocks Submit. The spec puts this check in the Guide workflow.\n- English text has to be both a title and a body, or left empty.\n- If an Admin has already taken a new Guide's usual slug, the new Guide gets `-2` on the end instead of crashing.\n- Admin-only pages and the nav now check a `manage_game` capability instead of the role name.\n\n**Review:** the two-part review found no hard problems. I fixed the real ones: an out-of-date Slug entry in `CONTEXT.md`, tests that guessed database ids, a leftover role check, and duplicated helpers. The findings and how each was resolved are posted on #4.\n\n**Left for later tickets:** the Markdown renderer has no language or warnings yet, and it doesn't refuse links starting with `/` (absolute paths). That has to be fixed before the Site build uses it.\n\nI left `notes/usage-ledger.csv` and `docs/transcripts/` out of the commit because they were already modified and untracked before this work."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":913,"cache_read_input_tokens":184001,"output_tokens":1063,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":913,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1063,"cache_read_input_tokens":184001,"cache_creation_input_tokens":913,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":913},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cg7rKEL1PapKE86E56ZqT","requestRef":"273c1cf1-0789-4f14-ae34-c497071b4cf2","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"51ffe895-1135-4b4e-9fea-b2522608887f","timestamp":"2026-10-17T13:00:19.539Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"b8adaffa-d625-4b74-9b79-27eafd538583","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8BPPahhVqjWZtee4Mw4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Ewpmd4UEL7FwVeY9ZqzieS","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh pr create --base main --title \"T03: Editors write and Submit Guides; Admins Publish them\" --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## Summary\n\nEvery change to a Guide's status goes through one Guide workflow module. It checks a capability (`user.can(...)`), never a role name. Routes only turn its answers into pages.\n\n```mermaid\nstateDiagram-v2\n    [*] --> Draft: create (Author)\n    Draft --> Draft: save\n    Draft --> Submitted: 提交审核 (Author; needs Chinese text; not under a Submission ban)\n    Submitted --> Submitted: save (Author or Admin)\n    Submitted --> Published: 发布 (Admin)\n    Draft --> Published: 发布 (Admin, own Guide only)\n    Published --> Published: save (Admin only; Editors will use a Revision)\n```\n\n```diff\n app/\n+├── guides.py          # Guide workflow: create, save, submit, publish, filters, counts\n+├── rendering.py       # render_markdown: markdown-it, then nh3 (preview now, Site build later)\n ├── accounts.py        # + User.can(capability), capability bundles per role\n └── routes/\n+    ├── guides.py      # content list, editor, preview, submit/publish buttons\n     └── dashboard.py   # + counts by status\n templates/admin/\n+├── guides.html        # list + status/Hero/Author/Patch/language filters\n+├── guide_edit.html    # Hero & Patch pickers, 提交审核 / 发布 buttons\n+└── guide_preview.html\n```\n\n- **Slugs:** a new Guide gets `<hero-slug>-<id>`. {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","hash":"04c9e786a9be7ed2197b4ea8cc1715c98c04576d263589d01db6afb96af82139","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GbCWHwHwadb3TXM6jXATxr","type":"tool_result","content":"63-- [ ] One GitHub issue labeled `spec`; 7–9 issues labeled `ticket`\n64-- [ ] A `/code-review` findings comment on every ticket before it closes\n65:- [ ] `docs/transcripts/` — one file per Claude session · `docs/handoff/` — at least one\n66-- [ ] `docs/process/compaction-log.md` — written by your hook\n67-- [ ] `notes/token-budget-plan.md` and `notes/usage-ledger.csv`\n68-- [ ] `docs/screenshots/` — 6 admin screens × 2 widths\n69-- [ ] `docs/iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md`\n70-- [ ] README with *Live URL*, *Run locally*, *Generative AI Use Statement*\n71-- [ ] Live site at `https://{username}.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/`\n72-- [ ] Tags `mp2-mvp` and `mp2-final` pushed\n73-\n--\n685-## Appendix B — Glossary\n686-\n687:**Slug** — the URL-safe version of a title (`spring-meeting-notes`). **Draft / published** — the status that decides whether the world sees a row. **Role** — a named bundle of permissions (*admin*, *editor*). **Tracer bullet** — a ticket that cuts a thin path through every layer, demoable alone. **ADR** — a short record of a decision that is hard to reverse. **Static export** — rendering database rows into plain HTML files. **CSRF** — an attack where another site submits your form using your logged-in session; the token in each form blocks it. **Sanitizing** — stripping dangerous HTML (like `<script>`) from user-written Markdown before showing it.\n688-\n689-## Appendix C — How you are graded (summary)\n690-\n691-Stage 1 is 15 points, Stage 2 is 85, and up to 5 extra credit if you are already at 70. Stage 2 factors: authenticity and judgment 17 · workflow fidelity 17 · CMS functionality 15 · security 8 · tests and code 8 · site and admin UX 7 · report and docs 6 · compliance 7. Every point is a checklist item, and every point you lose comes back with a specific fix. The full rubric is `docs/mp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md` in your repo — read it first, and run `check_submission.py` early and often.\n692-\n693-## Appendix D — Resources\n694-\n695-Claude Code docs: hooks `code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks` · status line `code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline` · usage and models `support.claude.com` · skills `github.com/mattpocock/skills` · GitHub Pages `docs.github.com/en/pages` · FastAPI `fastapi.tiangolo.com` · WordPress Playground `playground.wordpress.net`\n```\n\n- **ctx** — how full this conversation is. Fix with `/compact` or `/clear`.\n- **5h** — your rolling session window. When it hits 100%, you wait.\n- **wk** — your weekly cap. This is the one that can end your project week on a Thursday.\n\n### 5.3 The ledger, which writes itself\n\nThe same `Stop` hook appends one row per turn to `notes/usage-ledger.csv`:\n\n```text\nts,session,phase,provider,model,effort,ctx_pct,five_h_pct,weekly_pct\n2026-09-30T14:03:11Z,7c1a9b02,T03,anthropic,Sonnet,medium,52.0,31,18\n```\n\nThe `phase` column comes from `.claude/state/phase`. `CLAUDE.md` tells Claude to write the phase there when a stage starts, so labeling is automatic. Check it yourself at any time:\n\n```bash\ncat .claude/state/phase        # expect: grill, spec, tickets, or T03\n```","is_error":false}]}}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"f44405f1-089c-41a0-86aa-79e15295451e","hash":"36d5c8735bdf261dc361491a3386d303b7e00d4761badbc2291781dcb780c10a","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ed2yFBXiFWjL8Rh5KigvP1","type":"tool_result","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"SessionEnd hook: copy this session's transcript into docs/transcripts/.\n\nTranscripts are required evidence (rubric H2). Saving them automatically means\nyou cannot forget — in MP1 nobody remembered. The name follows the required\npattern; set CMS_STUDENT=first-last in .env (or your shell) so it is right.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef student_slug(project: Path) -> str:\n    name = os.environ.get(\"CMS_STUDENT\")\n    if not name:\n        env = project / \".env\"\n        if env.exists():\n            match = re.search(r\"^CMS_STUDENT=(.+)$\", env.read_text(), re.M)\n            name = match.group(1).strip() if match else None\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z-]\", \"\", (name or \"your-name\").lower().replace(\" \", \"-\"))\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    event = json.load(sys.stdin)\n    source = Path(event.get(\"transcript_path\", \"\"))\n    if not source.exists():\n        return\n    project = Path(os.environ.get(\"CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\") or event.get(\"cwd\") or \".\")\n    out = project / \"docs\" / \"transcripts\"\n    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    number = f\"{len(list(out.glob('*.md'))) + 1:02d}\"\n    target = out / (f\"iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_{number}_\"\n                    f\"{student_slug(project)}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.md\")\n    if not target.exists():\n        shutil.copy2(source, target)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    try:\n        main()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    sys.exit(0)\ndocs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_01_nick-chen_20261016.md\n     843 docs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_01_nick-chen_20261016.md\n   2 CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me-admin\n   2 CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=change-me-editor\n   2 CMS_SECRET_KEY=.*|CMS_SECRET_KEY=$KEY|\n   2 CMS_SECRET_KEY=change-me-to-a-long-random-string","is_error":false}]}}

The name follows the required\npattern; set CMS_STUDENT=first-last in .env (or your shell) so it is right.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef student_slug(project: Path) -> str:\n    name = os.environ.get(\"CMS_STUDENT\")\n    if not name:\n        env = project / \".env\"\n        if env.exists():\n            match = re.search(r\"^CMS_STUDENT=(.+)$\", env.read_text(), re.M)\n            name = match.group(1).strip() if match else None\n    return out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    number = f\"{len(list(out.glob('*.md'))) + 1:02d}\"\n    target = out / (f\"iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_{number}_\"\n                    f\"{student_slug(project)}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.md\")\n    if not target.exists():\n        shutil.copy2(source, target)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    try:\n        main()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    sys.exit(0)\ndocs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_01_nick-chen_20261016.md\n     843
